text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Avoidable cost is each arm's cost minus the perfect forecast's, over the scored year, July 2025 to June 2026, Boston and Skegness, Curtailment Limit 0. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Right: avoidable cost in GBP at the other prices, and in the DCUSA form. The limit is a multiple of each node's maximum before the scored year, a stand-in for the headroom NGED keeps. The NGED baseline is the maintainer's unconfirmed understanding of NGED's practice.'
text.tspan: Avoidable cost is each arm's cost minus the perfect forecast's, over the scored year, July 2025 to
June 2026, Boston and Skegness, Curtailment Limit 0. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from
resampling whole months. Right: avoidable cost in GBP at the other prices, and in the DCUSA form.
The limit is a multiple of each node's maximum before the scored year, a stand-in for the headroom
NGED keeps. The NGED baseline is the maintainer's unconfirmed understanding of NGED's practice.
